Overhaul v1.4.1d (28 November 2021) |previous_update = [[Overhaul v1.3|Frost Invasion Update]] |next_update = [[V1.0.0|Solar Eclipse Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Overhaul v1.4''' was the twenty-ninth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 4th of July 2021. This update is notable for being a 4th of July update. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''Overhaul v1.4''' has been retroactively applied to this update. The version encompassed twelve updates, the main Overhaul v1.4.0 update (released 4 July 2021) and eleven minor updates, the Overhaul v1.4.0a (released 5 July 2021), Overhaul v1.4.0b (released 10 July 2021), Overhaul v1.4.0c (released 21 July 2021), Overhaul v1.4.0d (released 22 July 2021), Overhaul v1.4.0e (released 8 September 2021), Overhaul v1.4.0f (released 21 September 2021), Overhaul v1.4.1 (released 22 September 2021), Overhaul v1.4.1a (released 9 October 2021), Overhaul v1.4.1b (released 1 November 2021), Overhaul v1.4.1c (released 26 November 2021) and Overhaul v1.4.1d (released 28 November 2021). ==Additions== *[[Toxic Gunner]] slowdown immunity *New skin for the [[Deluxe Crate]] **Skin: ***[[Accelerator]]: {{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} :In '''Overhaul v1.4.0b''': *New [[Codes|code]]: 1BILLION **Gives one [[Deluxe Crate]] :In '''Overhaul v1.4.1''': *[[Matchmaking]] BETA :In '''Overhaul v1.4.1b''': *New [[Codes|code]]: robloxisback **Gives one [[Premium Crate]] ==Removals== :In [[Firework]] not appearing in inventory when purchased. :In '''Overhaul v1.4.0b''': *[[Firework]] emote gamepass is taken offsale, making it unobtainable. :In '''Overhaul v1.4.0c''': *[[Military Base]] can no longer be placed down, but can still be equipped. :In '''Overhaul v1.4.0d''': *[[Military Base]] can be placed down again. *All units now spawn in a queue. *[[Autumn Falling]] remade.
